call_points.text: Order book split about 60% redevelopment and 40% PMC on a standalone basis
Board approved an SPV for a proposed CPSE REIT with 75,000 sq ft of rentable assets, subject to ministry and DIPAM approval
Board approved merger of wholly owned HSCC into NBCC for operational and financial synergies
Analysts pressed on repeated order slippage; management blamed statutory approvals and seed funding, and said MAHAPREIT may only start from Q3
Management declined to give a REIT timeline, saying it depends on gathering a considerable portfolio from CPSEs
Seychelles entrusted NBCC with another 1,000 houses after ~2,000 completed in Maldives; not in current projections
No numeric revenue, margin or capex guidance given; the deck lists order book conversion as a strategic action.
Largest Q4FY26 win was RIICO urban development and innovation projects at ₹2,100 Cr, PMC (Redev).
Overseas: BCD Global PMC pact (April 2026), Seychelles housing PMC engagement (April 2026), Pantheon Elysee and Goldfields MoUs (November 2025).

guidance.statement: Consolidated revenue target of ₹16,000-17,000 Cr for FY27
Consolidated revenue of around ₹21,000 Cr in FY28 and ₹24,000-25,000 Cr in FY29
Consolidated PAT of ₹1,100-1,200 Cr in FY27, ₹1,300-1,400 Cr in FY28 and ~₹2,000 Cr in FY29
Margin guidance of 6-6.5% PAT and 6.5-7% minimum EBITDA
Expects ₹50,000-60,000 Cr of new orders in FY27, including ~₹30,000 Cr from 5 GPRA colonies
Plans to award ₹20,000-25,000 Cr of works to contractors in FY27

operating_notes.text: Seven work orders totalling ₹176.28 Cr (excl. GST) were awarded in May 2026, all domestic project management consultancy, with no execution period stated.
The IIM Sambalpur order of ₹29.24 Cr is the incremental part of a ₹208.61 Cr Phase-II total, of which ₹179.37 Cr was intimated on 19.12.25.
Power Finance Corporation appointed NBCC project management agency for CSR projects worth about ₹103.47 Cr (excl. GST) across various states, with no execution period stated.
₹252.80 Cr (excl. GST) PMC order from Odisha School Education Programme Authority for GMAPV Scheme Phase-II in 46 schools; no execution period stated.
NBCC received work orders totalling ₹131.02 Cr (excl. GST) comprising ₹25.52 Cr from Central Bank of India and ₹105.50 Cr from Govt. of Andhra Pradesh.
NBCC received work orders totaling ₹52.14 Cr (excl. GST) comprising ₹20.15 Cr from Indian Overseas Bank and ₹31.99 Cr from the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare.
NBCC secured two work orders totaling ₹42.55 Cr comprising ₹6.92 Cr from Navodaya Vidyalaya Samiti and ₹35.63 Cr from Indian Bank.
Secured work orders totaling ₹83.24 Cr (excl. GST) on June 3, 2026.
Q1FY27 standalone order book ₹1,12,000 Cr split ~60% redevelopment and 40% PMC; consolidated ₹1,27,000 Cr.
Bharat Business Park fully sold in three auctions within three months, generating ~₹10,000 Cr; further ₹30,000-35,000 Cr of redevelopment fund generation expected this year.
Amrapali Phase 1 all 24 projects completed; Phase 2 in full swing with ₹4,000-5,000 Cr inventory to be sold at a 1% marketing fee.

timeline.summary: On 5 May 2026, NBCC reported seven domestic project management consultancy work orders totalling about ₹176.28 Cr (excl. GST), led by a ₹54.35 Cr Canara Bank order in Kochi.
On 7 May 2026, NBCC said Power Finance Corporation had appointed it project management agency for CSR projects worth about ₹103.47 Cr (excl. GST).

On 8 May 2026, NBCC said it had been awarded a ₹252.80 Cr (excl. GST) project management consultancy order from the Odisha School Education Programme Authority for the GMAPV Scheme Phase-II across 46 schools in Odisha.
On 13 May 2026, NBCC reported winning two project management consultancy work orders totalling ₹131.02 Cr (excl. GST) from Central Bank of India and the Government of Andhra Pradesh.
On May 15, 2026, NBCC reported winning domestic project management consultancy work orders totaling ₹52.14 Cr.
NBCC received project management consultancy work orders worth ₹42.55 Cr on May 23, 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹4,559.8 Cr (-1.8% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹241.39 Cr (+37.2% YoY).
On 3 June 2026, NBCC announced winning project management consultancy work orders worth ₹83.24 Cr.
Deepti Gambhir, NBCC (India) Limited’s Corporate Secretary, shared the video recording links for the investor meet held on June 1–2, 2026, discussing Q4FY26 and FY26 results.
On June 4, 2026, NBCC filed the details and video links of the investor meet held on June 1-2, 2026, along with a modified investor presentation.
NBCC (India) receives MCA corrigendum on first motion application for HSCC merger

status_history.evidence: Disclosed exchange intimation for ₹131.02 Cr work orders received on 13 May 2026.

Q1 business secured ₹1,600 Cr consolidated; management expects ₹50,000-60,000 Cr of new orders in FY27, but no exchange work-order intimations for the July-August wins (Seychelles ₹620 Cr, RBI Amravati ₹780 Cr, Rajasthan ₹431 Cr) are in this filing.
